basis: Andrew, 28 Oct 2026, asked whether the distribution board on GN23's units (1189078, Distribution Board Lifeguard 17) went with the 150 kVA generator at 09:45: "yes its that one". GN23's departure form offers only the generator, so the board's departure goes in GN23's note.

ops.text: Distribution board 1189078 (Lifeguard 17) left site with the 150 kVA generator 1297157, 28 Oct 2026 09:45 AEST (Andrew Fisher, 28 Oct 2026).
